environment: Linux Docker test runner, Python 3.12.15, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, real MinIO
command: docker compose -p stepwise-s3 -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.minio.yml --profile s3 --profile test run --rm tests pytest -q --cov=stepwise --cov-branch --cov-report=json:benchmarks/cloud-coverage.json --junitxml=benchmarks/cloud-tests.xml
notes: Parameterized software tests, not clinical validation.
Parent-process coverage does not include every forked RQ child line.
15 warnings: one Starlette TestClient and fourteen RQ test-harness fork deprecations.
